lines: כִּי בוֹ קָרְבוּ הַחֲטָאִים · אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן
וַאֲנִי נִצְלַבְתִּי עִמּוֹ · בּוֹ יָרוּם גְּאוֹנִי

review: All five stanzas open with the same refrain 'בַּצְּלָב, אֱלֹהַי' (في الصليب يا إلهى), which is the print's deliberate anaphora; hebrew-meter flags line position 1 as a constant across stanzas rather than a mismatch.
3:2 אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן — the Arabic أيها الرب العلى is rendered with the divine name, since the line's argument is 'You, the Lord on high'.
